comparison.objective: Carry a loose three-box stack to a shelf in one trip without separating or destabilizing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual squeeze transport of the bottom box while preserving an unsupported stack through lift, carry, and set-down.
comparison.success_condition: Stack never breaks specified separation/offset/tilt limits and ends level, supported, centered, and released on the shelf.
comparison.reason: This tests stability-preserving transport of multiple loose bodies, not mechanism commissioning.
